title: Compatibility: Multiply blend mode looks too dark compared to Forward+/Mobile
body: - *Related to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/96961 and https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/99549.* ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.5.stable, 4.7.2.stable, 4.8.dev c9730f40a ### System information Godot v4.8.dev (c9730f40a) - Fedora Linux 44 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor (3840x2160 @ 240.02 Hz) - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (nvidia; 615.71.09) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 62.33 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description The Multiply blend mode looks even darker in Compatibility compared to Mobile, where it's currently darker than in Forward+. Whether glow and/or HDR 2D is enabled will also affect its appearance, as this incurs a separate tonemap pass. This could be due to multiplication being applied to the sRGB output (while it should be done in linear space). ### Forward+ Glow OFF, HDR 2D OFF | Glow **ON**, HDR 2D OFF | Glow OFF, HDR 2D **ON** | Glow **ON**, HDR 2D **ON** -|-|-|- | | | ### Mobile Glow OFF, HDR 2D OFF | Glow **ON**, HDR 2D OFF | Glow OFF, HDR 2D **ON** | Glow **ON**, HDR 2D **ON** -|-|-|- | | | ### Compatibility *The DirectionalLight3D has shadows disabled in this scene, and there are no other light sources. Subtractive blending also looks odd (due to writing a transparent image) when both glow and HDR 2D are disabled. This is being addressed by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/109404.* Glow OFF, HDR 2D OFF | Glow **ON**, HDR 2D OFF | Glow OFF, HDR 2D **ON** | Glow **ON**, HDR 2D **ON** -|-|-|- | | | ### Steps to reproduce - Use the Compatibility renderer and the Multiply blend mode in BaseMaterial3D, and compare rendering with Forward+ where it looks as expected. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [test_blend_modes.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33485896/test_blend_modes.zip) Press G to toggle glow, and H to toggle HDR 2D. Set `const SCREENSHOT = true` in `node_3d.gd` to enable automated screenshots saved to `user://`.
